study type: Cluster-randomized controlled trial with a convergent mixed methods design
exposure: Maternal singing or humming during daily kangaroo care
cohort: Mothers (n = 36 in total, 24 intervention, 12 control) of preterm infants receiving daily kangaroo care in a neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: Maternal singing during kangaroo care significantly decreased maternal anxiety levels, relaxed mothers and infants, and supported their relationship by promoting emotional closeness and early interaction.
followup_time: Up to 40 gestational weeks (term equivalent) during neonatal hospitalization.
gest_age: Intervention performed during 33-40 gestational weeks among mothers of preterm infants.
